# Display-name null is a caller fallback signal

formatDisplayName can return null when it cannot supply an appropriate identity/address-book name. Own identities use context-specific localized Me only when unambiguous; multiple identities/custom header names need full mailbox representation. An address-book card overrides the identity result, with an empty card displayName yielding null. formatDisplayNameList owns the fallback to parsed header name/address, and-others suffix, and raw header. Preserve helper versus caller responsibility; the2024 change documents null rather than introducing it.

Scope: mail/display-names.

Paths:

- `mail/modules/DisplayNameUtils.sys.mjs`
